text: Resonant Words is a conduit for holy priests. It drops from the Lord Chamberlain in the Halls of Atonement and Halondrus in the Sepulcher of the First Ones. It is also sold by Zo'sorg in Oribos for .
Resplendent Mist is a conduit for Mistweaver monks. It drops from High Adjudicator Aleez in the Halls of Atonement and the Guardian of the First Ones in the Sanctum of Domination.
Resolute Barrier is a conduit for warlocks. It drops from Lady Inerva Darkvein in Castle Nathria, So'azmi in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market, and the Jailer in the Sepulcher of the First Ones.
Resilience of the Hunter is a conduit for hunters. It drops from Oryphrion in the Spires of Ascension and Sylvanas Windrunner in the Sanctum of Domination.
Resonance of Conflict is a reward from world quests in the Shadowlands.

The Resplendent Bastion of the Depths could be rarely looted from Ankoan Supplies or Unshackled Supplies, the caches for the Waveblade Ankoan and the Unshackled. Only classes with a tank specialization could loot it. Infusing the item at the Heart Forge will grant Rank 4 of the Aegis of the Deep Essence and leave behind a Battered Bastion.
Residue-Coated Muck Waders drop from the Corrupted Sediment at the Pool of Mixed Monstrosities in Maldraxxus.

The Resonating Elemental Heart is obtained by combining 36 Aqueous Reliquary, which drop from the Radiance of Azshara, the Queen's Court, and Queen Azshara in the Eternal Palace. Infusing the item at the Heart Forge will grant Rank 2 of the Condensed Life-Force Essence and leave behind a .
Resilient Seeds drop from Withered Lashlings and Withered Lashers in Arid Basin in Vol'dun for Resilient Seeds.
Requisitioner Packhounds are helhounds located in the House of the Chosen in Maldraxxus.
Requisitioned Anima Cells are offered for purchase for 5x Stygia by brokers Ve'ken and Ve'nott in Torghast, Tower of the Damned after players purchase and use the Loupe of Unusual Charm from Ve'nari.
Reserve Counterspies are inactive stoneborn located in Sinfall.
Reserve Enforcers are stoneborn located in Revendreth. In Sinfall, they are being carved by Sinfall Attendants, and a Sinfall Tutor channels anima into them.
Residual Anima are found in Seeping Cones in and around the Vault of Secrets of Korthia.

Research Report: Careful Examination was purchased from Archivist Roh-Suir at (honored) with the Archivists' Codex for 4,000 Cataloged Research at the Reliquary of Remembrance at Keeper's Respite in Korthia on the PTR. The item did not go live.

When patch 9.1.0 went live, the effect was rolled into the Relic Efficiency quest, offered at (honored) for free. This item is not account-wide. Each character must purchase and use the item to gain the additional relic fragments.

Researching Korthian Relics begins the Archivists of Korthia side chain, part of the Chains of Domination campaign, which eventually unlocks the Archivists' Codex faction and Cataloged Research drops. To start the quest, find the Researching Korthian Relics (item) item by opening containers in Korthia, like the Mawsworn Cache, or killing rare creatures for Conquering Korthia.

This item is account-wide — only one character needs to use it and all characters on the account will gain the buff while in Korthia. They must be killed — quickly — or they'll open a portal to escape. These treasure units start out

This item is account-wide — only one character on the account needs to use it and all other characters will gain the effect.

Resonating Sphere is a Preservation talent for evokers. It is an exclusive choice node with Nozdormu's Teachings.

Reservoir Spadefeet are hornswogs located at Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus.

Researchers Under Fire is a set of two timed scenarios located at at Ruins of Drekazera in the Sulfur Wastes of central Zaralek Cavern. The timed scenario runs hourly at the bottom of the hour (at xx:30). The scenario has players assist researchers Rannan Korren, Greta Herzig, and Thaelin Darkanvil as they investigate a Titan mining lockdown with their new niffen guides in the Zaralek Cavern. The adventurer Rannan Koren, a member of the Dragonscale Expedition, often heads into the fray before his colleagues are ready. This article deals with further speculation regarding retcons and other apparent discrepancies in Warcraft lore. It is left to the reader's opinion whether the discrepancies listed below constitute errors, retcons, flavor lore, or merely artistic license. The criteria for inclusion in this article is a clear, apparent contradiction between two official sources. Where the sources are reconciled by another official source, that explanation is provided. Theories attempting to reconcile the discrepancies by reference to other sources of lore may also be present.

The Restorative Potion is created with Alchemy (210); taught once by Badlands Reagent Run II. This item was also a quest reward from Uldaman Reagent Run.

Restless Spirits of Earth are earth elemental mobs found in the Sacred Grove on Azuremyst Isle. The destruction caused by the draenei's crash-landing onto Azuremyst has enraged these elementals, causing them to attack nearby Spirits of Water, Spirits of Fire, and Spirits of Air.

Restorative Totems is a Shaman talent in the Restoration tree. It provides a significant bonus to the mana restored by Mana Spring Totem and the healing done by Healing Stream Totem. It is a prerequisite for Mana Tide Totem further down in the Restoration tree.

Return to Angrathar concludes the main Scourge questline for the Alliance in Dragonblight, culminating in an impressive cutscene at Angrathar the Wrathgate. Resurgence is a talent for Restoration shamans. It grants the shaman mana on each critical Healing Wave, Healing Surge, Riptide, Unleash Life or Chain Heal.

Restored Mennaran Plate is a quest reward from Mystery of the Sarcen Stone.
Return Fire is an Alliance-only quest that pits the adventurer against the Horde forces attacking Astranaar in Ashenvale.

The Restless Front is a historic battlefield in south-west Tol Barad Peninsula. Wrecked siege engines and catapults still litter the area, and the restless ghosts of Alliance and Horde soldiers from the Second War continue to fight each other. Adventurers are tasked to retrieve spare parts from the siege engines in the quest Magnets, How Do They Work? (quest)

To complete this achievement, you must travel to the Shrine and find the Broken Incense Burner. Right-click on the burner to fix it, and so "follow in the footsteps of Chen" (see Trivia).

s release in 2019 the term Retail became a common way of referring to the contemporary Battle for Azeroth expansion.]] Retail is the modern World of Warcraft game including the most recent expansions. Blizzard also uses the development term mainline. These terms distinguish from Classic Era and Classic. Retail differs from Classic in that new expansions have always changed the game client and world for all players, including those who do not purchase the new expansion. For example, World of Warcraft: Cataclysm redesigned the game's original zones and affected all players from that point forward. The Revantusk tribe of forest trolls have constructed a well-fortified village on the coast of the Hinterlands. After learning of 's new Horde and his noble goals, the Revantusk trolls agreed to a pact of friendship and mutual assistance with the Horde. Their relation with the other forest trolls of the Hinterlands is mostly in the form of conflict.
Revenge of Gann is the 2nd quest in the Gann's Reclamation quest chain.

Revantusk Village is the only visitable settlement of the Revantusk tribe of forest trolls. You can find the port village on the coast of the Hinterlands. Before patch 1.11, you could get quests there which increased your reputation with the Revantusk troll faction. Now it is just a Horde settlement with reputation going to the Darkspear Trolls.
The player finds the dead body of Maur Grimtotem in Ragefire Chasm and returns the Grimtotem Satchel to Rahauro on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff.

Revenants are armored elemental creatures. They look similar to floating suits of crude armor. They also wield large maces and carry giant shields. The most notable revenant was the Guardian, protector of Frostmourne. Some are soldiers of the Old Gods in the Elemental Plane.

Revenant of Burning Souls was the sea revenant leader of an abandoned temple named Magistrate's Temple outside of Vol'jin's new base camp. Rexxar, Rokhan, Cairne Bloodhoof, and Chen Stormstout put this spirit to rest. For centuries, the Revenant of Burning Souls had collected the spirits of those who fell in battle against him. Their energy and life were stored within the Necklace of Burning Souls as a trophy of his numerous triumphs.
__NOTOC__ Revanchion is a wraith that appeared in Dire Maul West during the Scourge Invasion. Revanchion wanders the hallway behind Tendris Warpwood.
Return to Kristoff is the final quest in the Speaking of Fortitude quest chain.

Revelosh is a trogg found in the Hall of the Keepers in Uldaman. He carries The Shaft of Tsol, half of the Staff of Prehistoria needed to summon Ironaya. The other half, the Gni'kiv Medallion, is in Baelog's Chest.
Rex Ashil is a rare mob silithid wasp found in Hive'Ashi in Silithus.
The next to last step in a lengthy quest chain from Nathanos Blightcaller, this quest has you return to Nathanos after speaking with Crusader Lord Valdelmar in disguise in Tyr's Hand.
This is part of the main Blasted Lands quest chain, although it takes place in Stranglethorn Vale.

Return to Khadgar is part of a quest chain that was previously related to Karazhan attunement. While currently Karazhan can be entered freely, in the past this quest was required as it granted the The Master's Key, which indeed no longer exists in-game.
The Revered Mother's Crysknife is a quest reward from The Big Bone Worm.
This quest is part of the Report to Spymaster Thalodien quest chain. This quest chain starts with Report to Spymaster Thalodien
Reunion sends the player back to Rexxar with news from his father.
Rexxar's Whistle is provided as an objective for On Spirit's Wings.

This quest concludes the 500 Pound Chicken portion of the Blue Scepter Shard fork of The Scepter of the Shifting Sands quest chain to open the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj. Both the Narain's Scrying Goggles and the Draconic For Dummies: Volume II forks must also be complete before will offer the conclusion of the Blue Shard fork, The Good News and The Bad News.
The Reward Voucher is provided as an objective for the following quests: *The Platinum Discs (Alliance 2) *The Platinum Discs (Horde) (2)
Reverberation is a shaman talent that reduces the cooldown of your Shock spells. You must spend 15 points in the Elemental tree to max it.
Revenants of the Tides are sea revenant creeps that can be encountered in the Sunken Ruins tileset.
Revenants of the Seas are sea revenant creeps that can be encountered in the Sunken Ruins tileset.
The Rokk needs you to gather an unusual ingredient to make a special meal for the guest of honor at a party tonight - that ingredient is revenge!
Revelations is the seventh installment of the World of Warcraft comic.
Return to the Crossroads. is the 4th quest in the Meats to Orgrimmar quest chain.

Reunited is one of the two quests used to complete Infiltrating Voltarus. For players who have not finished Drakuru's chain in Grizzly Hills/Drak'Tharon Keep, they will be offered Dark Horizon instead.
Revenant's Treads are crafted with Northrend Leatherworking (75); Taught by Pattern: Revenant's Treads.
The Revenant's Breastplate is crafted with Northrend Leatherworking (75); Taught by Pattern: Revenant's Breastplate.
Revitalize (formerly Replenish) is a Druid talent in the Restoration tree, you will need to spend 12 points in the Restoration tree to max it.
Revi Ramrod is a goblin riding trainer located in the Orgrimmar Embassy of Orgrimmar.
Revilgaz's Cutlass is a quest reward from Turning the Brashtide.
Reverberating Shadowspirit Diamond is created with Cataclysm Jewelcrafting (40); taught by Design: Reverberating Shadowspirit Diamond.

__NOTOC__ Revival is a Mistweaver monk talent. Despite its misleading name, it is not a resurrection spell; for that, see Resuscitate. Instead, it is an emergency cooldown for mass burst healing. It is an exclusive choice node with Restoral.
Revelite Crystals can be found all over the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Reverberating Primal Diamond is created with Pandaria Jewelcrafting (50); taught by Design: Reverberating Primal Diamond.
Rexxus is a rare mastiff that can be found sleeping on the northside of The Cauldron in the Searing Gorge.
__NOTOC__ Revelations of Y'Shaarj drop from Garrosh Hellscream in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Reward Placeholders were found in Heafty Salvaged Crate in the WoD Beta.
Revel in Pain would have been a level 110 Vengeance demon hunter talent.
The Revitalizing Incense is a quest reward from Lieutenant of the Tower.
